title: 第1章 我才六岁就直升陆地神仙境界了第2章 陆地神仙之威碾压七皇子青帝瞩目
slug: 六岁皇子麾下竟全是陆地神仙
content_zh:
“尘儿，明天你就满六岁整了，同时，明天你将前往雏龙阁测试根骨悟性，一定不要紧张，知道吗？”
东苍域，大乾神朝！
帝都最中央的浩瀚辉煌的皇宫之中……
元秀殿！
一个身着淡蓝色宫袍，眉心中露出担心神色的女子看着眼前肉嘟嘟，虎头虎脑的小男孩，眼中流露出了慈爱的神色缓声开口。
“娘亲，你放心吧，尘儿明白！”
小男孩声音糯糯的开口。
“娘亲，我先回去休息啦，为明天养精蓄锐！”
安慰了一下母亲，陆尘不顾还想说什么的娘亲，快步回到了自己的房间。
好消息，陆尘是个穿越者！
坏消息，穿越到了一个玄幻世界，人命如草芥！
好消息，穿越到了大乾神朝，成为了大乾神朝一代中兴之主，青帝的儿子，拥有了人人敬畏的皇子身份。
坏消息，自己的娘亲原本是宫中的一个宫女，被青帝酒后乱性，因此诞生皇嗣，母凭子贵，被册封为元妃。
虽为皇妃，但是极不受宠，自从那一次之后，青帝就再也没找过自己娘亲，连带着自己这个十一皇子。也是众多皇子里最不起眼，最不受宠的一个！
更坏的消息，作为一个穿越者。竟然没有系统！
陆尘回到自己的房间，脸上露出了无奈，沧桑的复杂神色，和他六岁稚嫩的小脸蛋极为违和。
“统子，给我出来哦，你再不出来信不信我自杀，咱们一起嘎！”
随后，陆尘咧着小嘴，咬牙切齿的开口！
然而，这边，陆尘话音刚落。眼前突然出现了半透明的面板！
看到这里，陆尘突然愣住了，肉嘟嘟的脸上露出了诧异的神色。

【一岁，你出生于东苍域大乾神朝，成为了一个极不受宠的十一皇子。虽然出生以后，和自己的父皇青帝没有见过几次面，但是好歹在复杂的深宫之中活了下来！】
【六岁，到达了测试体质根骨和悟性的时候了，杯具出现了，你是一个百废之体，根骨极差，更是毫无悟性可言，至此，你悲惨的人生才刚刚开始】
【十二岁，因为你的废物体质，身为皇子，其他皇子都已经达到先天境界，你却在后天一重天寸步未进，此刻，你彻底成为了皇宫中一个被遗忘的小透明！
【十四岁，你母亲被灵妃污蔑，诬陷你母亲偷窥皇家藏经阁，青帝大怒，一怒之下把你母亲打入冷宫，你也被青帝处罚，被大打三十大板。虽然你愤怒异常，但是修为在后天三重天的你毫无办法，只能暗中舔舐伤口！】
【十六岁，你有了出宫建府的资格，被青帝随意的安排到帝都一个极为偏僻的外城建府，整个府中，连带你以及下人一共才十几人，至此。你成为了一个最寒酸的皇子！】
【三十岁，此刻你突然发现，原本辉煌无比的大乾神朝好像变得衰落了，内有宗门世家作乱，外有其他王朝扰乱边疆，大乾神朝突然陷入了战争当中，此刻你才后天六重天。实力甚至不如守城护卫，这个时候，你迷茫了！】
【四十岁，此时，大乾神朝已经危在旦夕，连续十年的征战，神朝内民不聊生，宗门挑战王权，妖魔屠戮生灵，大乾神朝疆域损失过半，而这个时候你突然得到消息，已经把你遗忘的父皇，大乾神朝的青帝，在一次闭关中走火入魔，身受重伤，危在旦夕！】
【五十六岁，此刻，你的境界仍然困在后天境界，距离先天境界遥遥无期。而就在这个时候，你的二哥，七哥联合四大宗门，四大世家逼迫已经奄奄一息的青帝退位禅让。
青帝被逼无奈，禅位于二皇子，二皇子称帝，封七皇子为一字并肩王，并把自己父皇青帝，以及自己的兄弟姐妹全部软禁起来，作为皇子，你同样逃脱不掉，被软禁于皇宫之中，不过幸运的是，虽然你被软禁了，但是你却有机会看到了几十年未见的母亲！】
看到眼前透明面板上不断出现的文字，陆尘整个人都懵懵哒。
这是什么情况？
我的一生嘛？
不是，作为穿越者，我这一辈子这么悲惨的嘛？
陆尘此刻整个人绷不住了。
然而，接下来，透明面板之上，文字继续缓缓浮现！
content_en:
"Chen'er, you will be six years old tomorrow. At the same time, tomorrow you will go to the Young Dragon Pavilion to test your understanding of the bones. Don't be nervous. Do you understand?"
Dongcang Territory, Daqian Divine Dynasty!
In the vast and glorious palace in the center of the imperial capital...
Yuanxiu Palace!
A woman wearing a light blue palace robe with a worried look on her eyebrows looked at the chubby little boy in front of her, with a look of love in her eyes and spoke slowly.
"Mom, don't worry, Chen'er understands!"
The little boy spoke with a waxy voice.
"Mom, I'm going back to rest first and recharge my batteries for tomorrow!"
After comforting his mother, Lu Chen quickly returned to his room, ignoring his mother who wanted to say something else.
Good news, Lu Chen is a time traveler!
Bad news, I have traveled to a fantasy world where human life is like a piece of grass!
The good news is that he traveled to the Daqian Dynasty and became the resurgence master of the Daqian Dynasty. He was the son of the Qing Emperor and had the status of a prince that everyone respected.
The bad news is that his mother was originally a maid in the palace, but she was drunk and had sex with the Qing Emperor. As a result, she gave birth to an imperial heir. The mother was named Yuan Fei because her son was noble.
Although she was an imperial concubine, she was extremely unpopular. Since that time, Emperor Qing had never looked for his mother again, not even with him, the eleventh prince. He is also the most inconspicuous and least favored among the many princes!
Even worse news, as a time traveler. There is no system!
Lu Chen returned to his room, with a complex look of helplessness and vicissitudes of life on his face, which was extremely inconsistent with his immature six-year-old face.
"Tongzi, come out. If you don't come out, believe it or not, I will commit suicide. Let's do it together!"
Then, Lu Chen grinned and gritted his teeth and spoke!
However, here, Lu Chen had just finished speaking. A translucent panel suddenly appeared in front of me!
Seeing this, Lu Chen was suddenly stunned, with a surprised look on his fleshy face.
[One year old, you were born in the Great Qian Dynasty of the Eastern Cang Territory and became an extremely unpopular eleventh prince. Although he had not met his father Emperor Qingdi several times since he was born, he managed to survive in the complicated palace! 】
[At the age of six, it’s time to test your physique, bones, and understanding. The cup has appeared. You are a broken body, with extremely poor bones, and no understanding at all. At this point, your miserable life has just begun]
[Twelve years old, because of your useless constitution, as a prince, other princes have already reached the innate realm, but you have not made any progress in the acquired realm. At this moment, you have completely become a forgotten little transparent in the palace!
[At the age of fourteen, your mother was slandered by Concubine Ling, who falsely accused your mother of peeping into the Royal Scripture Pavilion. The Qing Emperor was furious and sent your mother to the cold palace in a rage. You were also punished by the Qing Emperor and received thirty beatings. Although you are extremely angry, as you are in the third level of the day after tomorrow, you have no choice but to lick your wounds secretly! 】
[At the age of sixteen, you have the qualifications to leave the palace and build a mansion. The Qing Emperor randomly arranged to build a mansion in an extremely remote outer city of the imperial capital. There are only a dozen people in the entire mansion, including you and your servants. So far. You have become the most shabby prince! 】
[Thirty years old. At this moment, you suddenly find that the originally glorious Daqian Dynasty seems to have declined. There are sects and families in trouble, and other dynasties are disrupting the borders. The Daqian Dynasty suddenly fell into war. At this moment, you are only in the sixth level of the day after tomorrow. The strength is not even as good as the city guards. At this time, you are confused! 】
[At the age of forty, at this time, the Daqian Dynasty is in danger. After ten years of continuous war, the people in the dynasty are in dire straits, the sects challenge the royal power, demons slaughter all living beings, and more than half of the territory of the Daqian Dynasty has been lost. But at this time, you suddenly get the news that your forgotten father, the Qing Emperor of the Daqian Dynasty, went crazy during a retreat, was seriously injured, and is in danger! 】
[Fifty-six years old, at this moment, your realm is still trapped in the acquired realm.It is far away from the innate realm. And at this time, your second brother and seventh brother united with the four major sects and the four major families to force the dying Qing Emperor to abdicate.
The Qing Emperor was forced to have no choice but to cede his place to the second prince, who proclaimed himself the emperor. He named the seventh prince the King of Side by Side, and put his father, the Qing Emperor, and his brothers and sisters under house arrest. As a prince, you also cannot escape and are under house arrest in the palace. But luckily, although you are under house arrest, you have the opportunity to see your mother whom you have not seen for decades! 】
Seeing the words that kept appearing on the transparent panel in front of him, Lu Chen was completely confused.
What is going on?
My whole life?
No, as a time traveler, am I so miserable in my life?
Lu Chen couldn't hold himself any longer at this moment.
However, next, on the transparent panel, the text continued to slowly emerge!
